basic.description:
Restrict the export to one BASIC (the site's Download focus). Default all. crash_indicator exports crashes only.

Provider reference: allowed values ["all", "unsafe_driving", "hos_compliance", "driver_fitness", "drugs_alcohol", "vehicle_maintenance", "hm_compliance", "crash_indicator"].

200.description:
SAFER carrier name search (keywordx.asp): every carrier whose legal or DBA name contains the text, with its USDOT number, city/state and Company Snapshot URL. The site returns at most 500 matches and has no paging; `truncated` is true (and coverage partial) when that cap was hit, so narrow the name. A name that matches nothing is a successful empty result.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

200.description:
